name: Grand Piano with Bench
summary: Original glossy baby grand with open/closed lids, a lightweight 88-note keyboard and separate sittable bench.
description: Brand-neutral P1 black-lacquer baby grand for S15: curved bentside, brass-colored harp, three pedals and castered legs. One GLB contains lid_open/lid_closed variants, a separate bench and hidden collision proxies.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry; two shared materials with local vertex colors; no textures, external assets or text.

display.origin: Floor centre of the complete piano-and-bench footprint

keyboard.representation: 52 separated white solids and 36 raised chamfered black solids

accuracy_notes: glTF XYZ dimensions (width, height, depth): piano footprint 1.50 x 1.75 m, case top 0.993 m above floor; complete set 1.50 x 1.031 x 2.345 m closed; raised lid needs 1.812 m vertical clearance. Dimensions follow the original task; no global depth scaling. 88 closed key solids A0-C8, merged by material; 25 mm white-key thickness and 24 mm raised black keys. Pedals clear floor by 33.992 mm. Core glTF has no visibility flag: lid_closed is stored in opt-in VARIANT_LidClosed, collision proxies in opt-in COLLISION_ONLY; neither renders in the default scene. Bench is a separate floor-pivot node with a local seat anchor and facing direction; gameplay seating and collision registration remain the responsibility of the consuming application. No audio, playable keys or continuous lid animation. Full S15 assembly, physical devices and hardware performance remain unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials; no external models, fonts, textures or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

lid.mode: swap nodes under ASSET_GrandPiano; keep exactly one attached
